_comment: isiZulu API draft generated through the Anthropic API (2026-10-24) from ui.en.json, with the D4 strings as glossary. Native-speaker review required; the language stays labelled beta. Keys added later are an API draft generated through the Anthropic API (2026-10-26).
english_only_note: Ezinye izikrini zisesesiNgisini ngenkathi ukuhumusha kusahlolwa.
auth_demo_note: Idatha ye-demo eyenziwe — akuyena umuntu wangempela.

consent_body: I-Zaka isebenzisa imininingwane yemali oyifakayo ukukubonisa isilinganiso semali engenayo nephumayo nokuchaza izingozi ezingaba khona. Ungalungisa noma usule okufakile. Uma ucela i-Zaka ukuthi ihlole umlayezo, umbhalo ungase usetshenzwe yinsiza yethu ye-AI; qala ususe ama-PIN, amakhodi esikhathi esisodwa nemininingwane ye-akhawunti. I-Zaka ayithumeli imali futhi ayinqumi ukuthi uyafaneleka yini ukuthola isikweletu. Qhubeka kuphela uma uvuma.
consent_points_2: Asisoze sakucela i-PIN, i-OTP noma iphasiwedi yebhange.
onb_money_hint: Imali esephaketheni kanye nesebhange. Inani elicishe libe yilo lilungile.
onb_income_hint: Khetha konke okusebenzayo. Sizofunda nakulokho okufakayo.
onb_costs_hint: Sigcwalisa kusengaphambili lokho esingakwazi. Shintsha noma iyiphi inombolo ibe ngeyakho.
mode_bus: Ibhasi (MyCiTi, Rea Vaya, A Re Yeng…)

scam_intro: Namathisela i-SMS, i-WhatsApp noma i-imeyili. I-Zaka iqala iyihlole kule foni ukuthola izimpawu eziyisixwayiso ezivamile.
scam_low_body: Lokho akusho ukuthi uphephile. Uma ucela imali noma imininingwane, qala uqinisekise ngokwakho.
scam_explain_failed: Asikwazanga ukuthola incazelo manje. Izimpawu eziyisixwayiso ezingenhla zisasebenza.
scam_not_stored: Umlayezo wakho awugcinwa. Sigcina kuphela izimpawu eziyisixwayiso ezitholakele.

loan_intro: Faka imigomo ebhaliwe yobolekayo. I-Zaka iyihlanganisa ngamarandi.
loan_within_limit: Inzalo ingaphakathi komkhawulo osemthethweni walolu hlobo lwesikweletu.
loan_rights: Obolekayo akavunyelwe nanini ukugcina ikhadi lakho le-SASSA, ikhadi lebhange noma i-ID.
me_delete_confirm: Lokhu kusula i-akhawunti yakho nakho konke okufakile. Akunakubuyiswa. Bhala u-DELETE ukuze uqinisekise.
me_reset_demo_note: Kubuyisa amasonto angu-10 enziwe kaLerato, aphele namuhla.
me_about_body: I-Zaka yakhiwe yi-JustIT Solutions. Zonke izibalo zenziwa yikhodi efonini yakho futhi ziboniswa kokuthi "Kungani lesi kuyisilinganiso?". I-AI isetshenziswa kuphela ukufunda umusho owubhalayo nokuchaza izimpawu eziyisixwayiso zobuqola.
me_offline_cache: Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi: uhlelo lwakho lokugcina nokusha okufakile kugcinwa kule foni.
error_generic: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle. Okufakile kuphephile kule foni.
logout_pending: Okufakile okungu-{count} kusalinde ukuvumelaniswa futhi kuzolahleka uma uphuma manje. Uphume noma kunjalo?
loan_type_credit_facility: Ikhadi lesikweletu, ikhadi lesitolo noma i-overdraft
loan_cap_year: Umkhawulo osemthethweni: {rate}% ngonyaka (izinga le-repo {repo}% kanye nomkhawulo obekwe ngumthetho).
loan_simple_interest_note: Lapha inzalo ibalwa kuyo yonke imali isikhathi sonke. Uma ubuyisa ngezitolimende, inani olinikiwe lingase libe ngaphansi.
loan_rate_needed: Faka izinga lenzalo elisekhotheshini ebhaliwe ukuze uliqhathanise nomkhawulo osemthethweni.
loan_init_above: Imali yokuqalisa ingaphezu komkhawulo osemthethweni ka-{max} kule malimboleko.
loan_init_within: Imali yokuqalisa ingaphakathi komkhawulo osemthethweni ka-{max}.

loan_service_within: Imali yesevisi yanyanga zonke ingaphakathi komkhawulo osemthethweni ka-{max}.
loan_legal_source: Imithethonqubo ye-National Credit 42 no-44; izinga le-repo livela ku-SARB. Kuhlolwe ngo-{date}.
help_own_number: Sebenzisa inombolo ozitholele yona — ungalokothi usebenzise esemlayezweni.
help_use_saps: Bika ubugebengu noma unikeze ulwazi (amahora angu-24)
help_use_obs: Uma ibhange lakho lingasixazululi isikhalazo sakho
help_other_banks: Amanye amabhange: sebenzisa inombolo esemuva ekhadini lakho noma ku-app esemthethweni.
count_cash_body: Bala imali yakho esandleni bese uhlola imali esebhange. Faka isamba, u-Zaka uzobhala umehluko njengokulungiswa kwemali.
err_amount_too_big: Lokho kungaphezu kuka-R1,000,000. Sicela uhlole inani.
err_text_no_letters: Sicela usebenzise amagama, hhayi izimpawu noma izinombolo kuphela.
auth_password_rule: Sebenzisa okungenani izinhlamvu ezingu-8 ezinohlamvu nenombolo.
auth_cooldown: Uzame kaningi kakhulu. Zama futhi emizuzwaneni engu-{n}.
auth_rate_limited: Uzame kaningi kakhulu manje. Sicela ulinde umzuzu bese uzama futhi.
auth_signup_failed: Asikwazanga ukwenza leyo akhawunti. Uma usunayo, ngena kunalokho.
err_typed_long: Kude kakhulu. Kugcine ngaphansi kwezinhlamvu ezingu-200.
err_date_too_old: Okufakile kungabuyela emuva kuze kufike ku-1 January 2024.
err_date_too_far: Lokho kungaphezu kwezinsuku ezingu-7 phambili. Sicela uhlole usuku.
err_scam_long: Kude kakhulu. Namathisela kuze kufike ezinhlamvini ezingu-2,000.
err_scam_no_words: Namathisela umlayezo onamagama, hhayi ama-emoji noma izimpawu kuphela.
err_rate_limited: Ufake okuningi kakhulu ngomzuzu owodwa. Sicela ulinde bese uzama futhi.
loan_ranges: Inani R100 kuya ku-R1,000,000 · inzalo 0–100% ngenyanga noma 0–1,000% ngonyaka · isikhathi izinyanga ezingu-1–360 · izimali R0 noma ngaphezulu.
err_bill_day: Khetha usuku kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-31. Isikweletu sango-31 sikhokhwa ngosuku lokugcina lwezinyanga ezimfushane.
privacy_who_b: U-Zaka wenziwe yi-JustIT Solutions (Pty) Ltd (2026/025680/07), ePitoli, eNingizimu Afrika. Sibhaliswe ku-Information Regulator. Isikhulu sethu Solwazi ngu-Phenyo Matlou. Xhumana: support@jis-tech.co.za.
privacy_collect_b: I-imeyili nephasiwedi yakho (egcinwe ngendlela evikelekile) ukuze ukwazi ukungena. Imininingwane yemali oyifakayo (amanani, izigaba, izinsuku, amanothi, izikweletu, imigomo nezilungiselelo) ukuze u-Zaka akubonise uhlelo lwakho. Ku-Scam Shield sigcina kuphela izinga lobungozi nezimpawu eziyisixwayiso ezitholakele, hhayi umlayezo. Sibala izicelo ze-AI ukuvimba ukuxhashazwa, ngaphandle kokuqukethwe kwazo.
privacy_never_b: Asikaze sicele noma sigcine i-PIN yakho yasebhange, amaphasiwedi esikhathi esisodwa (ama-OTP) noma imininingwane yokungena ebhange. U-Zaka akaxhumani nebhange lakho futhi akakaze adlulise imali. Uma ufaka i-PIN ye-app, ihlala efonini yakho njengekhodi efihliwe futhi ayikaze ithunyelwe kithi.
privacy_ai_b: Uma usebenzisa okuthi Bhala noma ucela u-Scam Shield achaze umlayezo, lowo mbhalo uthunyelwa ku-Anthropic (Claude, United States) ukuze kutholakale impendulo. Asiwugcini umbhalo. Susa ama-PIN, amakhodi nezinombolo ze-akhawunti ngaphambi kokunamathisela umlayezo. Zonke izibalo zemali zenziwa yikhodi efonini yakho, hhayi yi-AI.
privacy_where_b: I-akhawunti yakho nokufakile kugcinwe ku-Supabase eLondon, United Kingdom, kuvikelekile ukuze nguwe kuphela ongakufunda. Ifoni yakho igcina ikhophi ukuze u-Zaka asebenze ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi; ukuphuma kuyayisusa.
privacy_keep_b: Kuze kube uyakususa. Mina → Susa imininingwane yami kususa i-akhawunti yakho nakho konke okufakile kanyekanye. I-akhawunti ye-demo esetshenziswa yibo bonke inemininingwane eqanjiwe kuphela.
privacy_rights_b: Ungabona, ulungise noma ususe imininingwane yakho, futhi uphikise indlela esiyisebenzisa ngayo. Thumela i-imeyili ku-support@jis-tech.co.za. Ungakhala futhi ku-Information Regulator: inforegulator.org.za.
privacy_advice_b: U-Zaka unikeza izilinganiso ngokwemininingwane oyifakayo. Akusona iseluleko sezimali, sezikweletu noma sezomthetho, futhi akanqumi ukuthi uyafaneleka yini ukuthola isikweletu. Hlola izinqumo ezibalulekile nomeluleki oqeqeshiwe.
notfound_body: Isixhumanisi kungenzeka sesidala noma sibhalwe kabi. Uhlelo lwakho lwemali luphephile.
feedback_thanks: Siyabonga! Umbono wakho usisiza ukwenza u-Zaka abe ngcono.
feedback_pick_stars: Sicela ukhethe izinkanyezi ezingu-1 kuya ku-5.
feedback_limit: Usuthumele umbono izikhathi ezingu-3 namuhla. Siyabonga!
feedback_failed: Asikwazanga ukukuthumela manje. Sicela uzame futhi emuva kwesikhashana.
share_message: Ngisebenzisa u-Zaka ukuhlela imali yami: ungibonisa imali engingayisebenzisa kuze kufike imali yami elandelayo. Zama naku:
pin_body: Okwamafoni asetshenziswa ngabaningi. U-Zaka ucela i-PIN uma evuleka nangemva kwemizuzu engu-5 ungekho. I-PIN ihlala kule foni kuphela.
pin_weak: Leyo PIN ilula kakhulu ukuqagela. Gwema u-1234, 0000, 1212 nokunjalo.
pin_set: I-PIN ifakiwe. U-Zaka uzoyicela kule foni.
pin_wait: Uzame kaningi ngephutha. Linda imizuzwana engu-{n}.
pin_wait_short: Uzame kaningi ngephutha. Sicela ulinde kancane.
pin_wiped: Uzame kaningi ngephutha. Ukuze uphephe, u-Zaka uphumile futhi wasusa konke kule foni.
pin_forgot: Ukhohlwe i-PIN? Ngena futhi ngephasiwedi yakho
scan_privacy: Izithombe nama-PDF afundwa kanye ukugcwalisa okufakile, bese elahlwa. Uhlola konke ngaphambi kokuthi kugcinwe.
scan_offline: Ukuskena kudinga i-inthanethi. Gcina isiliphu usiskene kamuva, noma usifake ngesandla.
scan_try_sample_body: Lezi ngamasiliphu ESIBONELO angeyona angempela. I-Zaka iwafunda njengelangempela.
scan_err_offline: Ukuskena kudinga i-inthanethi. Gcina isiliphu usiskene kamuva, noma usifake ngesandla.
scan_err_not_a_slip: Lokho akubukeki njengesiliphu noma inkokhelo. Zama isithombe esicacile sesiliphu sonke.
scan_err_unclear: Angikwazanga ukufunda inani kahle. Zama futhi ekukhanyeni okuhle, noma ulifake ngesandla.
scan_err_too_big: Lelo fayela likhulu kakhulu. Izithombe kumele zibe ngaphansi kuka-1.5 MB, ama-PDF angaphansi kuka-3 MB.
scan_err_unsupported_type: I-Zaka ifunda izithombe (JPG, PNG, WebP) nama-PDF kuphela.
scan_err_pdf_encrypted: Le PDF inephasiwedi, ngakho i-Zaka ayikwazi ukuyifunda. Thatha i-screenshot yayo esikhundleni.
scan_err_pdf_pages: Ama-PDF angaba namakhasi angu-3 kuphela. Thatha i-screenshot yekhasi olidingayo.
scan_err_rate_limited: Uskene kakhulu ngesikhathi esifushane. Sicela uzame futhi emva kwesikhashana, noma ulifake ngesandla.
scan_err_unavailable: Ukuskena akusebenzi manje. Sicela uzame futhi, noma ulifake ngesandla.
scan_check: Nakhu engikufundile. Hlola yonke imininingwane ulungise okungalungile ngaphambi kokugcina.
scan_check_low: Angiqiniseki ukuthi ngikufunde kahle. Sicela uhlole yonke imininingwane ngokucophelela ngaphambi kokugcina.
scan_sample_fallback: Ukuskena kumatasa manje, ngakho le yimininingwane ephrintiwe yesiliphu sesibonelo. Yihlole bese uyagcina.
scan_big_confirm: Elinye inani likhulu kakhulu. Lilungile? Thepha futhi ukuze ugcine.
scan_saved: Okufakile okungu-{count} kugciniwe kusuka esiliphini sakho.
privacy_slips_b: Izithombe nama-PDF amasiliphu afundwa kanye ukugcwalisa okufakile futhi awagcinwa. Athunyelwa ku-Anthropic (Claude) ukuze afundwe, bese elahlwa; kugcinwa kuphela okufakile okuhlolile wakugcina. Izinombolo zekhadi, ze-token, ze-akhawunti nezikamazisi ziyafihlwa futhi azigcinwa.
auth_signup_done: Kwenziwe. Uma le imeyili intsha, i-akhawunti yakho isilungile (hlola imeyili yakho uma sicela ukuqinisekisa). Uma usuvele unayo i-akhawunti, sebenzisa iphasiwedi yayo. Thepha u-Ngena ukuze uqhubeke.
scam_not_message: Lokhu akubukeki njengomlayezo okumele uhlolwe. Namathisela i-SMS, i-WhatsApp noma i-imeyili oyitholile.
type_it_off_topic: Ngingabhala kuphela imali engenayo noma ephumayo. Zama: ngithole u-R350 emsebenzini wesikhashana.
